meaningKo: 더 가볍게 생각하다; 너무 심각하게 여기지 않다
exampleEn: You need to lighten up and enjoy the moment.
exampleKo: 너는 좀 가볍게 생각하고 순간을 즐겨야 해.
gameExamples: Sometimes we just need to lighten up and laugh at our mistakes.
If you keep worrying, you won’t be happy; try to lighten up a bit.
You should lighten up when you're with friends and just have fun.
